summary: The reboot module reboots a host and waits for it to go down, come back, and respond. PATH is ignored when locating shutdown, so use search_paths; Windows uses win_reboot.
questions: How do I reboot a server and wait for it to come back?
Why can't the reboot module find shutdown?
How do I reboot Windows hosts with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Reboot and wait
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.reboot` reboots, waits for down/up, and runs a test command. `PATH` is ignored when finding `shutdown`; use `search_paths`. Windows: `ansible.windows.win_reboot`.
